_about: Standing backlog (Chief, 12 Oct 2026; Ben: the Mini works 24/7). scripts/refill.py adds the next of these to the queue whenever fewer than 3 Mini jobs are ready. Every item is no-spend (no Vertex, Flow, ElevenLabs or any paid call), never deletes anything, never makes a video public, never replaces an armed Test & Compare, and ends parked for Chief (PASS gate) unless it only reads. A key is not re-added while a job from it is open or claimed, nor within every_h of the last one; if nothing at all is ready the oldest key is added anyway (never empty). Lowest tier: jobs.order runs backlog jobs only when no pipeline job is ready. Weekly audits and idea/script drafts for both channels lead (Ben, 12 Oct 14:36).

items.title: Weekly OWB audit: our YouTube numbers + competitors -> next-video improvements
items.body: Weekly growth audit for Orbit With Ben (aim: numbers up month on month). 1) Pull last 28 days and last 7 days from YouTube Analytics with the read-only tracker sign-in (YT_ANALYTICS_REFRESH_TOKEN_OWB; 05_Analytics tools): views, impressions CTR, AVD/retention curves, subs per video, Shorts vs longs, traffic sources, search terms. 2) What's working and what isn't: top/bottom 3 by CTR and retention, with the frame or title that explains it. 3) Competitors: 5 reference channels (Astrum, History of the Universe, SEA, Kurzgesagt, melodysheep) last 30 days via public pages/yt-dlp metadata only: titles, thumbs, lengths, view velocity, topics trending. 4) Write 05_Analytics/weekly_audit/OWB_<YYYY-MM-DD>.md: findings, then 3-5 concrete changes for the next films in production (title/thumb/opening/length/topic), each tied to a film id, plus 3 new video ideas ranked by evidence. Compare with last week's file and say what moved. Spend nothing: existing subscriptions and free tools only, no paid API, no TTS or picture generation in these growth jobs (credits are for pipeline VO and picture; floors are 0, Ben 12 Oct 14:46), no Studio or publish change. End with jobs.py block <id> --reason "parked for Chief: <what to decide>" --git.
